title: refactor(spec): share the form object-name resolver with lint
body:
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTHQmGisuNMkvo5hbWyoWo5)_

Fixes #25756

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

The rung order that resolves the object an open anonymous form submits into (the form's `data.object`, else the view's `list.data.object`, `form.data.object`, `object`) was typed twice: as `anonymousFormObjectName` in `@objectstack/metadata-core` and as `candidateObjectName` in the lint rule `validate-public-form-file-fields`. It now lives once, in `@objectstack/spec/ui` beside `anonymousFormIntakeCandidates`.

- `packages/spec/src/ui/anonymous-form-intake.ts`: declares and exports `anonymousFormObjectName`; the docblock no longer says it stays in metadata-core.
- `packages/metadata-core/src/anonymous-form-intake.ts`: re-exports the spec function. The consumers (rest `form-routes.ts`, `rest-server.ts`, metadata-protocol `runtime-authoring-gate.ts`) import from metadata-core unchanged.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-public-form-file-fields.ts`: imports it from `@objectstack/spec/ui`; `candidateObjectName` is gone.
- Pins: the metadata-core identity test now also holds `anonymousFormObjectName` to be the spec binding itself (module and barrel); a lint test pins that the rule imports it from `@objectstack/spec/ui` and keeps no retyped copy.
- Generated: `api-surface/ui.json` and `export-origins/ui.json` (one added export); one changeset.

## Behaviour effect (stated, as ordered)

Lint's old helper went through `viewObjectName` (view-walk.ts), which also reads `objectName` on a raw input and skips non-string or empty values. The shared function is the doors' own raw read and does neither, so lint now judges exactly the object the doors resolve. A form that sets `objectName` (not a spec key) or an empty or non-string `object` no longer binds an object in this rule; the doors never honoured those either, so the rule no longer judges a form the doors cannot reach. No producer in the repo was found relying on the old reading.

## Measurements

- `git grep candidateObjectName -- packages`: 0 hits after the change.
- `git grep "v.list?.data?.object" -- packages` still hits lint-view-refs.ts:185, an unrelated candidate list (the card's own correction).
- Landing point as expected; no other producer package found.

## Acceptance notes

Gate and test readings are in the os-dev report comment on #25756.
